name: FAN TAN (SEVENS)
description: Fan Tan, also widely known as 'Sevens', 'Domino', or 'Parliament', is a classic layout-based card game where the objective is to be the first to get rid of all your cards. Players build upon a central layout of cards, starting with the Sevens and expanding outward to the Ace and Two in each suit. It is a game of both luck and light strategy, as players can choose to hold back key 'blocking' cards to prevent opponents from playing.

content.text: Fan Tan, also widely known as 'Sevens', 'Domino', or 'Parliament', is a classic layout-based card game where the objective is to be the first to get rid of all your cards. Players build upon a central layout of cards, starting with the Sevens and expanding outward to the Ace and Two in each suit. It is a game of both luck and light strategy, as players can choose to hold back key 'blocking' cards to prevent opponents from playing.

Originating in the 19th century or earlier, the game has many names across different cultures: 'Parliament' in the UK, 'Domino' or 'Sevens' in many Western countries, and 'Fan Tan' (distinct from the Chinese gambling game of the same name).
3 to 8 players. 4 to 6 is considered optimal.
Standard 52-card pack. Cards rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2 (Ace high).

Dealer shuffles and player to dealer's right may cut. Dealer deals all cards one at a time, clockwise, starting with player to dealer's left. Some players may have one more card than others - this does not matter.
